response.sql: WITH per_item AS (SELECT oi.order_item_id, AVG(1.0 * ili.product_price / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS item_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_count FROM Order_Items AS oi LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id) SELECT AVG(item_ratio) AS overall_average_ratio, AVG(1.0 * line_count) AS average_invoice_line_items_per_order_item FROM per_item

assumptions.assumption: A zero derived_total_cost produces an undefined ratio, which is skipped.
